Account help

How do I reset my password?
Click Forgot Password on the login page, enter your email address, and we'll send you a reset link that expires in 24 hours.
Can I change my subscription plan?
You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your account settings.
What payment methods do you accept?
We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers.

Availability

Can I access my account history?
Your complete account history is available from the dashboard.
Premium feature information
Upgrade your plan to access premium feature information.
How do I update my email address?
Update it in account settings and confirm the verification email.
